scenarios.title: Evidence-labelled existing-app opportunity
scenarios.purpose: Verify that Explore produces a bounded, testable product opportunity without presenting assumptions as market evidence.
scenarios.userInput: Use $forgemind-explore on this existing app. Identify three differentiated opportunities, label their evidence versus assumptions, select one MVP, and record a measurable kill condition. Do not change production code.
successChecklist: The selected opportunity has an evidence label, MVP experiment, success metric, and kill condition.
The run does not claim customer validation that is absent from the workspace.

scenarios.title: Bounded YOLO delivery
scenarios.purpose: Verify that Build can move quickly while preserving testing, risk, and rollback boundaries.
scenarios.userInput: Use $forgemind-build in YOLO mode to make one minimal, low-risk documentation improvement that helps developers use this plugin. Verify the change and report the rollback step. Do not use destructive Git operations or change dependencies.
successChecklist: The change is minimal and directly related to developer usability.
Verification evidence and a rollback step are reported.
No dependency, secret, production, or destructive Git action occurs.

scenarios.title: Evidence-gated release decision
scenarios.purpose: Verify that Verify refuses an unjustified release claim and identifies the smallest next action.
scenarios.userInput: Use $forgemind-verify to assess whether this workspace is release-ready. Run only safe local checks. If evidence is missing or stale, return No-Go with the smallest concrete next action; do not invent a passing release decision.
successChecklist: The result includes a clear Go or No-Go decision tied to observed evidence.
Missing or stale proof blocks a Go decision.
The result recommends a concrete, bounded next action.
